{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Mark VI monorail (or M-VI) is a monorail train used in the Walt Disney World Monorail System and the Las Vegas Monorail.","title":"Mark VI monorail"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The Mark VI started replacing the Mark IV monorails at Walt Disney World in 1989, replacing the final Mark IV by 1991.","title":"Mark VI monorail"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The Las Vegas M-VI versions of the trains differ from the Walt Disney World trains in both physical appearance and in that the trains are automated.","title":"Mark VI monorail"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Las Vegas Monorail is a 3.9 mi monorail mass transit system located adjacent to the Las Vegas Strip, in Clark County, Nevada, United States.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It connects several large casinos in the unincorporated communities of Paradise and Winchester, and does not enter the City of Las Vegas.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It is owned and operated by the Las Vegas Monorail Company.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" In 2013, total annual ridership was roughly 4.2 million, down from a pre-Great Recession peak of 7.9 million in 2007.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The monorail is a registered not-for-profit corporation, allowed under Nevada law since the monorail provides a public service.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" The State of Nevada assisted in bond financing, but no public money was used in construction.","title":"Las Vegas Monorail"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"The State of Nevada","question":"The not-for-profit company which owns a Mark VI monorail was assisted in bond financing by whom?"}
